stories.name: Discovery 1: Energy
stories.text: The vacuum was never empty. Beneath its silence, a patient dynamo found the first trace of energy.

stories.name: Discovery 2: Particles
stories.text: At first the detector registered isolated sparks. Soon the particle stream became a pattern you could sustain.

stories.name: Discovery 3: Atoms
stories.text: The first atom held together. A small arrangement had turned passing motion into something with a memory.

stories.name: Discovery 4: Matter
stories.text: Matter gathered in the crucible. You learned that building one thing often means slowing another.

stories.name: Discovery 5: Planetary mass
stories.text: An orbit formed around a growing world. The nursery required patience, but its structure endured.

stories.name: Discovery 6: Stellar fuel
stories.text: Deep within the reservoir, fuel waited for its moment. Abundance was useful only when the next process could receive it.

stories.name: Discovery 7: Starlight
stories.text: A star opened its light into the dark. You could begin again now, carrying understanding instead of mass.

stories.name: Discovery 8: Stardust
stories.text: Stardust traced the history of a vanished furnace. You sent probes to read what production alone could not explain.

stories.name: Discovery 9: Gravity
stories.text: Gravity drew distant structures into conversation. Your constellation was becoming an arrangement of choices.

stories.name: Discovery 10: Dark matter
stories.text: The dark lens revealed an unseen scaffold. What looked empty had been guiding the visible cosmos all along.

stories.name: Discovery 11: Spacetime
stories.text: Spacetime folded around a causal anchor. You chose a law and discovered that every advantage carried a consequence.

stories.name: Discovery 12: Universes
stories.text: The first universe was a beginning, not a conclusion. Beyond it lay another experiment, and another way to arrange the possible.
